name: Goo Goo Dolls
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 pop-2000s — Goo Goo Dolls
notes: A punk band turned power-ballad machine, and the entry's defining fact is a tuning rather than a progression: the 1998 single uses a **BDDDDD** tuning, "so chords are open-string drones with movable single-finger shapes rather than functional triads". That is what the chord block encodes — open voicings, a harmonic rhythm pinned to two bars a chord, and short families that behave as drones rather than cadences. 74–138 straight with the backbeat on 2&4 and the ballads at 74–105; the research also states that the 51/156 catalogue readings are algorithmic artefacts of the record's 4/4-to-6/8 metre changes, which is why neither value bounds the session. Three drum deltas are quoted: "kick 1 and 3", "ride 8ths under the chorus", and "a full-bar tom fill into each chorus" plus "the drums drop out entirely for the a-cappella-ish bridge" — the ride/tom/crash perc block, an 8-bar big-fill schedule and a high `dropOutBeats`. The bass is "roots, long notes under the droning guitars, with a slide up to the chorus root", which is `mirror_kick` with a real `glideProb`. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research rates it high-medium. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are all drum probabilities and `bpm.mode` 96; the metre alternation itself is not encodable in a 4/4 generator and is named here instead. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“played bass on roots, long notes under the droning guitars, with a slide up to the chorus root.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord.
